# RB-04 Stale answers and overdue rechecks

Scope: NabaLens internal. Back to the [index](README.md).

| Field                         | Content                                                                                           |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Trigger                       | M-KN-3, M-KN-4                                                                                    |
| Operator role                 | OPS                                                                                               |
| First checks                  | Check the recheck job heartbeat and that an open, owned recheck task exists for the slot and use. |
| Steps                         | The venue rechecks or reaffirms the answer; the task closes when the slot reads current again.    |
| Narrowest switch              | A question version with no freshness policy (B03 rollback)                                        |
| Switches in the catalogue     | SW-01 (Knowledge working list (per venue and question))                                           |
| Data implications             | The previous answer is kept and shown to managers; consumers read it as stale.                    |
| Pending delivery              | A stale answer is withheld by read-time rules; no delivery is paused.                             |
| Readback that proves recovery | The reader returns the slot as available and current for the use.                                 |

## Checks without a database

- None. The claims need a database; see the drill.

## Drill

- Description: Freeze time past max_age with the job stopped: the reader reads stale/expired. Run the job twice: one task. Reaffirm: the task closes.
- Readiness: waiting (waiting for B03, OD-15 fixture policy)
- Status: not_exercised
- Environment: an owned isolated stack only, never production or a shared database.
- Evidence: `evidence/b10-02/RB-04/`
